title: Reranker quantization pipeline: FP8/INT8 robustness audit and NDCG/MRR regression suite
creator: Priya Nair
description: Goal: Build an automated calibration + evaluation pipeline to validate FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles for the production reranker model and produce per-release gating signals based on NDCG/MRR and user-level regret. Scope includes: implement reproducible calibration workflows (per-layer and per-channel options), run large-scale ranking-quality evaluations (NDCG@1/3/10, MRR@10), and generate query-slice and adversarial stress reports. Deliverables: a CI job that runs on every quant-profile candidate, dashboards with per-slice regressions, and an automated rollback/fallback policy recommendation for rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Automated pipeline runs end-to-end in CI for both FP8 and INT8 profiles and produces a JSON report
NDCG and MRR baseline comparisons available for full testset and five annotated slices (long queries, short queries, paraphrase-rich, low-click items, noisy inputs)
Gating rules defined: no slice-level NDCG drop > 0.5% and overall MRR drop < 0.3% for candidate to pass
Dashboard populated with per-query delta distribution and percentile-based thresholds (p50/p95/p99)
Integration hooks for rollout automation: if candidate fails gating, route traffic to compatible model variant via smart-routing policy
steps: Define calibration dataset: sample 100k diverse query-document pairs across production traffic windows
Implement calibration runner supporting fp8 and int8 modes (per-layer/per-channel toggles)
Run calibration sweep with temperature/scale search and store linearization parameters
Execute ranking evaluation harness: compute NDCG@1/3/10 and MRR@10; compute per-query score deltas vs baseline
Add slice extraction scripts (length, click-entropy, lexical overlap, paraphrase indicators)
Produce CI artefacts: JSON report, artifacts link, and notify Slack channel #reranker-quant
Wire gating result into rollout rule config in console (canary threshold override)
Ship dashboards and alert if any slice shows degradation beyond thresholds
tradeoffs: FP8 often reduces memory and improves throughput but can introduce subtle distributional shifts that require more careful calibration relative to INT8
Per-channel calibration gives better accuracy at cost of slower calibration and larger metadata; per-layer is faster but less precise
Tighter gating reduces customer risk but increases iteration time for model rollouts and may block beneficial cost-saving profiles
Using a small calibration set speeds experiments but risks overfitting scale factors; prefer cross-validation folds when possible
blockers: Need access to the 100k production-sampled calibration set (privacy approval pending), infra ticket for increasing CI runner GPU quota (INFRA-5582), and final model artifact naming convention from model-onboarding
